judge.voice: Jo, the A1 was right and the summary was nice. It said I know park, ball and creeper, and I liked that. But the tasks were too long. The homework one I just guessed, because it was moc dlouhé. The question about my block I only half understood. After that I was done. It felt a bit like school. The "slip" line told me to change "I like diamond", but that was fine already. I'd try it again if the questions were tiny and about Minecraft. A tiny sentence and a creeper joke would work better. I'd tell a friend only if it were shorter.
